scope: Alpha-boundary Flame Wrap with GPU mask prepass and optical pass. Rust owns validation and phase; Creator supplies authoring DSL and UI transports exact values. This is not installed/full-editor/encoded-export acceptance.

contract.seed: Integer 0..65535, enforced at Host editing admission and native render resolution.
contract.boundary: Eight-neighbour alpha >= 0.5, transparent holes and canvas exterior, directional distance rather than exact Euclidean SDF.
contract.color: sRGB to linear premultiplied compositing and back to straight sRGB.
contract.budget: Per-frame axes <=8192, pixels <=16777216, logical loads <=4000000000. Not driver/RSS or performance acceptance.

native.scope: Includes actual native module/public-contract checks and shared phase tests; distinguishes historical rlib/binary and duplicate executions.

wasm.scope: Pinned release compiler with --no-opt --locked --offline. Correction of the uncompiled Rust integration-test fixture after this build is separately recorded; no current-all-source equality claim.

authoring.scope: Actual helper/export/copy plus jsdom ReactDOM controls. Editor/catalog/keyframe observation transport doubles are explicit; UI history not verified.

gpu.scope: Exact fetched buffer hashed and compiled, actual WASM/compositor presentation Canvas. Positive controls prove visible refraction and time-varying flame/sparks. No independent full shader oracle or native pre-presentation-byte claim.

host.scope: Actual HeadlessHost HTTP, Creator helper, nine static controls, seven animation channels, detached author resource load, FileProjectStore memory/byte invariance and recovery. GPU work budget requires frame execution and is not claimed from Host apply.

notVerified: Real production editor parameter undo/redo and same-project reload/render/export chain
